registration: New limited physical-time numerical experiment registered before first new E27 computation. Prior original E8b static, E17D0 dimensionless impulse, E17D1 synthetic time and E17D2B1 conditional Wechsler histories already known; NO new calibrated halo or observational hypothesis.

immutable_numerical_inputs.mass_trajectories: Exactly original E17D2B1 two M0 physical Msun anchors times alpha=0.4,0.8. Conditional Wechsler M(z)/M0=exp[-alpha*(z-z0)/(1+z0)].
immutable_numerical_inputs.halo_density: EXTERNAL COMOVING POINT-MASS potential U(k)=1 in original Class h=.6736 cosmology; no finite-size M200c conversion, no LRG/ELG occupation.
immutable_numerical_inputs.background: Original E9 state-specific H_CLASS in inverse comoving Mpc, linear interpolation only on original 0.95<=z<=1 z nodes.
immutable_numerical_inputs.T_nu0: 0.71611*2.7255*8.617333262e-5 eV from original cosmology code and original E9 T_ncdm; m_nu=.06 eV.
immutable_numerical_inputs.kernel: Original E17D0 finite-q H_F(s) with s=k_comoving*(T_nu0/mnu)*integral_{zobs}^z[(1+zp)/H_CLASS(zp)]dzp. Halo lookback distance dX=(v_h/c)*integral dz/H_CLASS. Complex halo-frame phase exp(+i*k*mu*dX).
immutable_numerical_inputs.output: Finite-window z=1 to .95 Born scalar delta_nu(k)/nbar_nu per EXTERNAL conditional point-mass halo Fourier source; in Mpc^3, not force, acceleration, beta, epsilon, galaxy chi, xi or survey odd.
immutable_numerical_inputs.amplitude: Use 4*pi G M0/(c^2*k) and mnu/Tnu0 point-mass Fourier potential plus exact source-time cancellation of a; G=4.30091e-9 Mpc (km/s)^2 /Msun (fixed convention).
immutable_numerical_inputs.integration: Trapezoid physical z grid 129 and 257 inclusive. Every F original 4000q piecewise-linear q with original E17D0 GL2 source kernel. Quantify quadrature change without posthoc thresholds.
immutable_numerical_inputs.tests: Original source blob and SHA, z/H interpolation domain, original fixed parameters, q denominator positive, 129 vs 257 convergence 5e-3 normalized full complex, mu reversal/conjugation, zero wind imaginary zero, alpha histories anchored, tenfold M0 response scaling, unknown pre-z1 wake explicitly excluded.
